(()=>{const A=__CITY_APP,r=A.renderer,s=A.scene;const orig=r.renderObject;const acc=new Map();let on=false;const root=o=>{let p=o,last=o;while(p&&p!==s){last=p;p=p.parent}return last.name||last.type};r.renderObject=function(object,scene,camera,geometry,material,group){if(on){const g=geometry||object.geometry;const n=(g.index?g.index.count:(g.attributes.position?g.attributes.position.count:0));const inst=object.isInstancedMesh?object.count:(g.instanceCount&&g.instanceCount!==Infinity?g.instanceCount:1);const pass=camera.isOrthographicCamera?'shadow':'view';const k=pass+' '+root(object)+(object.name?'/'+object.name:'');const e=acc.get(k)||[0,0];e[0]+=1;e[1]+=n*inst/3;acc.set(k,e)}return orig.apply(this,arguments)};let frames=0;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{on=true;requestAnimationFrame(function f(){if(++frames<10)return requestAnimationFrame(f);on=false;r.renderObject=orig;const rows=[...acc].map(([k,[d,t]])=>[k,d/10,Math.round(t/10)]);const by=(p)=>{const m=new Map();rows.filter(x=>x[0].startsWith(p)).forEach(([k,d,t])=>{const top=k.split('/')[0];const e=m.get(top)||[0,0];e[0]+=d;e[1]+=t;m.set(top,e)});return [...m].sort((a,b)=>b[1][1]-a[1][1]).map(([k,[d,t]])=>k+' draws '+d+' tris '+(t/1e6).toFixed(2)+'M').join('
')};console.log('[tri]
'+by('view')+'
'+by('shadow')+'
[tri-top]
'+rows.sort((a,b)=>b[2]-a[2]).slice(0,25).map(x=>x[0]+' d'+x[1]+' '+(x[2]/1e6).toFixed(2)+'M').join('
'))})})})()
